cc:Work.dc:title: WallMounted - WallRack
cc:Work.dc:description:
Wall mountable rack for spices or other items
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes WallRack --x 180 --y 50 --sh '100*2' --top_edge e --thickness 3 --labels 1 --reference 0 Command line short: boxes WallRack --x --sh --top_edge --reference
